comment: C ref: cmd.c rhack() (3731-3735, 3803-3825) and do_repeat() (1637-1660). rhack() puts every command but #repeat and '#' into CQ_REPEAT before it runs, and its result tail keeps the queue for a plain ECMD_OK: reset_cmd_vars(gm.multi < 0). dodiscovered() (o_init.c:764-873), doattributes() (insight.c:2009-2019), dovspell() (spell.c:2021-2053) and ddoinv() (invent.c:3006-3009) return ECMD_OK from every exit, so ^A after each window opens it again. Escape at the command prompt runs reset_cmd_vars(TRUE) (3660-3669) and empties the queue, so the last ^A reports that there is no command to repeat. A Healer, who starts with discoveries and spells, on a seed, clock and key sequence chosen independently.
